label_without_box.base_definition: A visible annotated source has a verified finding and category but no box. Other views remain eligible.

label_with_box.base_definition: A visible annotated source has a verified finding, category and valid source-coordinate box.

multiple_labels.base_definition: More than one verified finding is attached to the visible source; use supported sets or unambiguous referents.

missing_category.base_definition: Finding evidence exists but its clinical_group is absent or cannot be mapped unambiguously.

unlabelled_neighbor.base_definition: The focused context frame has no positive annotation; absence of annotation is not a negative target.

explicit_normal_reference.base_definition: The recipe has an explicitly annotated normal comparison reference distinct from the target.

multiple_verified_anchors.base_definition: At least two displayed same-finding positive anchors have verified frame identities in one video.

annotation_assisted_input.base_definition: The displayed input contains an annotation-derived crop or overlay; assistance must be declared.

unmapped_or_conflicting_reference.base_definition: A required label, geometry, role or provenance reference is unresolved or contradictory.

TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_COMPLETENESS_SPECIFICA.reference_policy: One reference position per (video_key, frame_index), regardless of repeated crops/overlays; it need not be positively annotated.
TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_COMPLETENESS_SPECIFICA.target_policy: Only explicitly positive same-video frames strictly before/after the reference; no bbox or category requirement.
TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_COMPLETENESS_SPECIFICA.unknown_policy: Unlabelled frames may be reference positions, never automatically positive or negative targets. Missing annotation support is not clinical absence.
TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_COMPLETENESS_SPECIFICA.empty_target_policy: Record not_applicable with a reason; do not author a negative answer or silently drop the unit.
TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_COMPLETENESS_SPECIFICA.conflict_policy: Record review_required for unresolved frame order, provenance or source contradictions.
TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_COMPLETENESS_SPECIFICA.deduplication_policy: Repeated views of one physical frame do not multiply reference positions. Distinct reference/direction predicates remain separate units; semantic families identify reused evidence across presentation variants.
TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_COMPLETENESS_SPECIFICA.audit_obligation: Recompute expected unit keys and known-positive frame sets independently of emitted decisions, then check missing, extra, duplicate and wrongly classified units.
